story: An icon of the skies, the Indian Blackbird (Otus bakkamoena) is a species from the Strigidae family. It thrives in Forests; fields; orchards; villages; parks; gardens; and urban areas, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Indian Blackbird is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Indian Blackbird helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Indian Blackbird, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
